title: a sealed run's snapshot carries no waiting metric
intention: A sealed run's snapshot carries no waiting metric: the instance seal's copy of ~/.cairn keeps each holder's metrics recorder directory and leaves its records behind, so a metrics collect under the seal cannot land the live recorder's records into the shared metrics table a second time.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: ticket 98ab0e9db57f's tooth 7, sealed, read metrics totals of 66,405 migrated rows per name against 22,135 in the dump; the live recorder had not drained since the migration, and each sealed run's collect over the snapshot wrote its copied records into the live table. A dedupe removed 199,215 copies.
how: The snapshot's ignore hook copies each metrics recorder empty; a red-first proof over a temp instance root.

clauses.claim: a snapshot of an instance root whose holder's metrics recorder waits with a record keeps that recorder's directory and reads empty through metric.recorder, while the live recorder still holds its record
the same snapshot copies the holder's other data recorders and its other files byte-equal
the tester's charter says the snapshot leaves waiting metrics behind

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/tester/isolation.py: import cairn.tools.metric.metric (the metric tool's public interface). A new function _is_metrics_recorder(directory) is True when the directory's name is metric.RECORDER, its parent's name is 'data_recorder' and its grandparent's name is 'tools'. _snapshot_ignore returns set(names) for such a directory, right after the logs-tree branch, so the directory is copied empty. Nothing else in the module changes.

D2: the charter cairn/devices/tester/intention+why.json, through the artifact door (cairn artifact write --verb cast --from a scratch copy): its 'what' gains, appended after one space, exactly this sentence: "The snapshot leaves waiting metrics behind: each holder's metrics recorder is copied as an empty directory, because its drain lands in the one shared metrics table and a copied record would land twice." Every other field stands.

D3: the proof cairn/devices/tester/proofs/test_a_snapshot_carries_no_waiting_metric.py, red-first, one tooth per clause, PROVES 5bcceb08973f 1-3. Its world is a temp instance root swapped in for isolation._INSTANCE_ROOT with the pristine cache reset and restored; it records one metric through metric.Metric, writes a second recorder's file and a plain file, and takes isolation.pristine_snapshot().
